steps.title: The arrow
steps.say: The green arrow points from the old demand curve D1 to the new one, D2. It shows the whole demand curve shifting to the right.

steps.title: Why right means more
steps.say: Moving right means more quantity is wanted at every price, so buyers want more than before. That is what a demand rise looks like.

ops.text:
Right = more bought
at the same price

steps.title: The new balance
steps.say: With D2 crossing the supply curve higher up, the new equilibrium has a higher price and a larger quantity. That is why price rises when demand rises.

ops.text:
New point: higher price,
more quantity
